blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Canonical V2 USDx gates blacklist/unBlacklist with RESTRICTION_ROLE. All balance changes pass through _update restriction and pause checks; transferFrom also checks the spender. The runtime at Ethereum block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z) matches the verified implementation. Complete deployment-to-pin role history finds no active RESTRICTION_ROLE or PAUSER_ROLE holder, contrary to the issuer's generic Compliance-role description, but the governance Safe can grant either immediately. The verdict records admin-grantable direct transfer-freeze capability, not an active staffed restriction role or token seizure. Pinned RPC: https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com.

oracleRisk.summary: Axis Market API supplies the RFQ terms in a user-signed order; an authorized operator accepts or rejects it and settles atomically. The contract does not independently value collateral against an external price oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: Offchain RFQ pricing determines primary-market USDx and collateral exchange amounts. USDx has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation engine requiring collateral-branch reviews. Order-signature integrity does not establish independent price discovery for settlement.

sources.label: Axis collateral valuation is not enforced by an external oracle
